name: M. Kline
role: Mandan cigar maker, maker of the "De Mores" brand
bio: M. Kline of Mandan advertised in the Cow Boy in early 1884 and made a cigar brand called the "De Mores," which the paper said was already a favorite. In March 1884 he wrote that he would come to Medora to see the dealers, and in June 1884 he spent three days in town, when the boys put him on a bronco that ran away with him four times.

As many of our friends can testify, Mr. Kline sent that box of cigars and the "De Mores," as the new brand is called, is already an established favorite. The cigars will soon be on sale.
Mr. Kline, of Mandan, has written us that he will be here next week to talk to our dealers on the cigar question. His "De Mores" brand is destined to be a great favorite here.
M. Kline, of Mandan, left Monday for home, after a three day's business and pleasure trip here. The boys let him off easy and mounted him on a bronco that only ran away with him…
